<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion appears at m/z ≈ 199, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. The neutral mass is therefore about 198 Da. The formula that best matches this mass using only C, H, O (and possibly another element X) is C₁₀H₁₄O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H14O4</final_answer>
